set.body: Seed all top-level RNG (test_gpca.R:3 worst); loosen iterative tolerances (1e-9/1e-10 -> ~1e-6, subspace comparisons); sign-align raw factor comparisons; add real tests: gpca_mle loglik monotone, rpls lambda=0==PLS-SVD + properties, truncate vs direct fit, transfer round-trip + source/target alias, randomized same-seed/diff-seed determinism, RNG-stream-unchanged; fix dead skip (gmd_randomized_cpp_dn exists() -> genpca:::), un-skip or CRAN-safe eigen-vs-spectra equivalence; gep_subspace 0.3 tolerance.
set.title: Phase 3: test hardening
